findings.quote: and I had Captain Crunch so I left him there next to it as a sort of-I don t know. A trade.
findings.claim: He did not leave the fossil. It is his and it must be on his own shelf for the last chapter of the book to happen.
findings.fix: He set the two side by side and brought it home.

all five resolved. Captain Crunch unambiguously still his. The critic was asked whether giving Elena the striped stone breaks anything later and found it does not - nothing in canon requires that stone to stay with him, unlike the fossil.
